name: mosparo Integration
description: Integrates mosparo (privacy-friendly spam protection) with server-side verification. Anti-abuse-positive.
project_description:
Back to top 

 About mosparo 
 mosparo is the modern spam protection system. It provides an alternative to the existing CAPTCHA solutions by simply checking the form data instead of trying to check if someone is a human or a robot.

 Back to top 

 About this module 
 This module adds the needed functionality to add mosparo to your Drupal forms. It is compatible with the following modules:

 
 CAPTCHA 
 Contact (Core module) 
 Webform 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use 
 You need your own mosparo installation to protect your forms with this module. Read more about how to use mosparo on our website: mosparo.io/how-to-use 

 Back to top
